category: professional training / communication and leadership education
problems: The active official site contains repeated and contradictory freshness/experience claims across the homepage and current conversion page: 11 years, 12 years, and 14 years appear in different sections, weakening trust in an education brand selling authority and transformation.

The site repeats near-identical comparison blocks for 'Outras Escolas' and 'Transformatória' and repeats multiple enrollment forms for unnamed tiers, making the offer structure difficult to scan and obscuring the next best action for individual learners versus companies.
Several visible copy-quality defects reduce professional credibility, including 'Prêmio Qualidade Brasil 2017/1018', 'Certificado válico pelo MEC', and 'Método Acceletared Learning'.

The current site makes high-stakes numeric and outcome claims such as '+24 mil formados', '98,6 NPS', 'ganham até 8x mais', and 'vendem 6,5x mais' without a clearly surfaced methodology or proof context, creating avoidable skepticism for prospective learners and B2B buyers.
rebuild_angle: Create a sharper two-audience training experience: a credible individual path from communication diagnosis to the right formation, and a separate B2B path from team problem to tailored in-company proposal, preserving the theatrical, transformational energy while removing proof ambiguity and copy noise.
active_evidence: On 2026-07-19, https://transformatoria.com.br/ loaded as the official Escola Transformatória site and presented online, in-person, VIP, and in-company communication/oratory training; named founder Heverson Barbosa and trainers; testimonials; course and book offers; a Curitiba address at Alameda Princesa Izabel, 573; and active lead forms. The official contact route also presented current conversion content with a free two-minute diagnosis, 14 years, +24,000 students, +80 companies, and 98.6 NPS claims. OpenStreetMap/Nominatim matched the published address to Curitiba.
preserved_strengths: The distinctive 'school of protagonists' and communication-as-transformation positioning.
The clear split between individual development and company training potential.
The stage, microphone, filmed-practice, and live-experience cues stated on the official site.
The founder and trainer-led authority structure.
The direct diagnostic and enrollment conversion intent.
The energetic, aspirational tone, without copying the current layout, text, or imagery.

colors: The official site uses a high-energy dark presentation with strong contrast and theatrical visual cues; exact palette should be sampled from original captures before implementation.
typography: The official site presents bold display-style headings and compact sans-serif supporting text; exact typeface is not asserted in the collected evidence.

concept_thesis: Turn the stage into a decision system: diagnose the communicator or team first, then reveal one credible training route with theatrical energy, human proof, and a single unambiguous next step.
